_comment: Canonical handshake lines as each client emits them. The Rust suite (wire_fixture.rs) asserts the LIVE parser accepts every one; recall's tests/test_mic.py asserts the Python client still produces its line byte for byte. The Kotlin/Swift lines are copies of what Handshake.kt / Handshake.swift format. Editing a client's line here without both suites green is the drift this file exists to catch.
